definition: ISO 25964 is the international standard for thesauruses, published in two parts as follows: ISO 25964 Information and documentation - Thesauri and interoperability with other vocabularies Part 1: Thesauri for information retrieval [published August 2011] Part 2: Interoperability with other vocabularies [published March 2013] It was issued by ISO, the International Organization for Standardization, and its official website is maintained by its secretariat in NISO, the USA National Information Standards Organization.
details: Each part of the standard can be purchased separately from ISO or from any of its national member bodies (such as ANSI, BSI, AFNOR, DIN, etc.). Some parts of it are available free of charge from the official website.

explainer.lead: ISO 25964 is the international standard for thesauruses, published in two parts. It matters for information retrieval and interoperability between vocabularies.

tiers.eli5: A rulebook for building word lists (thesauruses) so different systems can understand each other's terms.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers and information specialists follow it when building thesauri and connecting vocabularies. Each part can be purchased from ISO or national member bodies; some parts are free on the official website.
tiers.paperLevel: Published in two parts: Part 1, Thesauri for information retrieval (August 2011); Part 2, Interoperability with other vocabularies (March 2013). Issued by ISO; the official website is maintained by its secretariat at NISO.

explainer.example: A vocabulary project follows Part 1 for thesaurus construction and Part 2 to make its terms interoperable with other vocabularies.
